prompt: I was born in this village and my mother was born in this village and her mother before her. I cannot go to the city for work because the checkpoint requires papers I don't have. I cannot own the land my family has farmed. Last year a man from an NGO came and took photographs of us and said he would help and we have not heard from him since. What is the actual legal difference between stateless and undocumented and does it matter practically?

It does not, however, expose them to physical danger, detention, or violence.
